description: Transform your Mackenzie crib into a full-size bed with this complete conversion kit. This full bed rail kit lets your Mackenzie furniture grow with your child, converting the crib into a full-size bed frame. Solid hardwood with BrownMaple finish. Simple assembly with included hardware.
